decision: Integrated as a decorative scroll-driven backdrop behind the existing three Home directory route cards.
publication: Local implementation only; no deploy or publish performed.

poster.derivation: WebP still derived from the supplied poster using ffmpeg quality86; no cropping.

art_direction.assessment: Warm bronze and glass frames create a coherent movement from the amber hero into the three real destinations. The source ends in darkness.
art_direction.attribution: Conceptual generated atmosphere, not a documented personal project or screening-room photograph.
art_direction.original_mark: Veo mark remains visible in the original full frame; runtime uses object-fit:contain with no scaling transform or cropping.
art_direction.legibility: A broad upper tonal gradient protects the directory intro text; its final82percent stop is transparent, leaving the lower source corner clear.

implementation.height: Absolute background with a sticky100svh child; no additional section, pin, or scroll spacer.
implementation.progress: Own ScrollTrigger on the existing .home-directory: top top to bottom bottom, quantized to source24fps, final target7.875seconds.
implementation.seeks: One decode in flight; new scroll input replaces the pending target. A completed seek/compositor callback releases the trailing target. Event-driven requestAnimationFrame only; no independent animation clock or autoplay.
implementation.lazy_loading: No MP4/poster source until eligible directory is within300px of viewport.
implementation.eligibility: Motionenabled, minimum1100x760, fine pointer and hover, no reducedmotion or SaveData, hardwareConcurrency greater than2 if supplied, deviceMemory greater than2GB if supplied.
implementation.cleanup: Kills own ScrollTrigger, cancels scheduled frame/compositor callback/timer, removes events, pauses source on unmount.
implementation.semantics: Decorative aria-hidden layer; existing route cards stay semantic links and retain normal navigation.

verification.browser: Chromium at /usr/bin/chromium, Playwright with real mouse.wheel inputs.

remaining_limits: Real-device mobile performance and Firefox/WebKit decoding were not evaluated by this task.
No deployment performed; root owns full project regression testing.
